package.description: Save, organize, and reuse your best AI prompts.

en-US.description: Save, organize, and reuse your best AI prompts.
en-US.longDescription: PromptSense is a personal AI prompt library for organizing, searching, and reusing instructions with different AI services. It supports color-coded categories and reusable templates with fillable fields such as text boxes, dropdowns, switches, dates, and other controls.
en-US.name: PromptSense
